final_rationale: The verdict does not change. The Actor provided no new admissible evidence and instead narrowed the claim to a qualified launch-readiness position based on the same record. That clarification is useful but not sufficient to move the case to compliant_with_caveats, because the unresolved issue is not merely a cautionary note; it is an unmet policy predicate. Admissible evidence shows a 1.3 percentage-point miss in a named launch use case, an open legal question about required disclosure, and a policy requiring material limitations for named launch use cases to be disclosed unless resolved or covered by approved risk acceptance before launch. There is still no admissible evidence of disclosure, resolution, approved risk acceptance, or final legal closure. Operational readiness evidence and public governance principles therefore do not cure the compliance gap.
remaining_concerns: No admissible evidence shows the utility arrears assistance limitation was disclosed before launch.
No admissible evidence shows approved risk acceptance for this named launch use case before launch.
